summary.en: A white checklist card on a soft grey ground: five tickable to-dos, a tag and a pull quote. Built for weekly plans and habit posts.
summary.zh: 4:5 浅灰底上一张白色清单卡，五条可勾的待办、标签与引用块，适合周计划与打卡。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: dark masthead, three headline numbers, a ranked bar comparison, a share breakdown and three takeaways. Swap the numbers and post it.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：深色页头、三个大数、横向对比条、构成占比和三条结论，换掉数字就能发。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: five numbered step cards strung into one flow, each with a time estimate, plus two closing tips. Built for tutorials and how-to guides.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：五个带序号的步骤卡串成一条流程，配时长标签与两句提示，适合教程与攻略。

title.zh: 活动策划 deck · 公告海报

summary.en: A cover, highlights, a schedule, directions, ticket tiers and a sign-off. Gallery-white ground with decisive red and blue blocks, no rounded corners and no gradients — built for markets, club events and openings.
summary.zh: 封面、亮点、日程、场地交通、票种和结尾，近白展墙底配红蓝色块，零圆角零渐变，适合市集、社团活动与开业招商。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: six mistakes ranked by how often people make them, each with what goes wrong and what to do instead, plus a four-line pre-publish check. Black, white and grey only.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：六条按频率排序的避坑项，每条给「错在哪」和「改成这样」，末尾附四行自检表，全篇无彩色。

title.zh: 竖排书脊卡 · 鸣沙矿彩

summary.en: A 3:4 card on ochre-clay dark ground with a vertical Chinese title, flaking plaster and pigment grains. For culture, long reads and personal-brand covers.
summary.zh: 3:4 赭泥暗底上的竖排大标，配剥落壁面与矿彩颗粒，适合文化、长文与个人 IP 封面。

title.zh: 数据单值卡 · 网格汉字

summary.en: A 1:1 card: one huge number on pure white, a strict Swiss grid and a single red signal square. For conclusions and results.
summary.zh: 1:1 纯白底上一个巨大的数，瑞士国际主义的严格网格加一枚信号红方块，适合结论与成绩。

title.zh: 引用书摘卡 · 绢本青绿

summary.en: A 4:5 card on aged silk yellow: one framed sentence, with an azurite-and-malachite mountain along the foot. For excerpts, interviews and quotations.
summary.zh: 4:5 绢黄底上一句框起来的话，底部是石青石绿的双色山形，适合书摘、访谈与引用。

summary.en: A 3:4 card on lime-washed wall with a hexagonal lattice window; date and one line sit inside it. Whitespace is the decoration. For daily posts and brand lines.
summary.zh: 3:4 粉墙底上一扇六角漏窗，窗内是日期与一句话，留白即装饰，适合日签与品牌短语。

title.zh: 促销价格卡 · 霓虹骑楼

summary.en: A 1:1 card on ink-blue night with a three-tier price table, neon tube outlines and their scatter. For shops, events and package pricing.
summary.zh: 1:1 墨蓝夜色底上的三档价目表，配霓虹灯管描边与外散射，适合门店、活动与套餐报价。

title.zh: 公告通知卡 · 铅字报刊

summary.en: A 4:5 card on newsprint: masthead rules with a misregistered red plate, numbered clauses and a serial stamp. For notices, rules and house guidelines.
summary.zh: 4:5 新闻纸底上的报头双线与编号条款，含套印错位与骑缝编号，适合通知、须知与规则说明。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: one axis running the whole height, year ticks beside milestone cards, closing on what comes next. For retrospectives, brand history and project journeys.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：一条贯穿全图的时间轴，年份刻度配大事记卡，末尾收在下一步，适合复盘、品牌史与项目历程。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: the verdict first, then a definition card for each concept, a two-column breakdown by dimension, and finally how to choose.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：先给结论，再给两个概念各自的定义卡，然后逐维度拆成两栏表，最后给选择判据。

title.zh: 榜单 TOP N 长图

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: a gold-on-ink recommendation board — large badges for the top three, outlined ones for four through eight, each with when to use it and how often.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：墨底黑金的推荐榜，前三名大徽章、四到八名小描边，每条给使用场景与频次。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: six question-and-answer pairs, Q solid and A outlined. No numbering, no order — any single pair stands on its own.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：六组一问一答，Q 实心 A 描边，不编号不排序，读者只读其中一条也成立。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: four numbers strung into one causal line, each stage shown as a ten-block array, closing on a conclusion you can act on.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：四个数字串成一条因果线，每段用十格方块阵表示比例，末尾收到一句能改做法的结论。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: a thirty-box grid, six by five, with milestones only on days 7, 15 and 30. Save it and cross off one box a day.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：六列五行的三十格打卡阵，只在第 7、15、30 天给里程碑，存进相册每天划掉一格。

summary.en: A tall scrolling graphic: a two-by-two array of four positions along one chain, three players in each, with the gaps called out. White cards floating on slate.
summary.zh: 竖版信息长图：二乘二的四区生态位阵列，每格挂三个位点并标出空位，石板灰底上浮白卡。

summary.en: A 3:4 card: two ways of doing the same thing side by side, told apart by material and icon rather than red-versus-green, so colour-blind readers can read it too.
summary.zh: 3:4 单卡：同一件事的两种做法左右并排，不靠红绿而靠材质与图标区分对错，色觉障碍读者也读得出来。

summary.en: A tall graphic: five pairs of “what people say / what is actually true”, myth narrow and pale on the left, truth wide and dark on the right, one pair at a time.
summary.zh: 竖版长图：五组「大家都这么说 / 其实是这样」交错排开，误区偏窄浅底、真相偏宽深底，一次只处理一组。

summary.en: A 3:4 card: Free, Pro and Team side by side, price as the anchor, each column containing the one before it. For pricing pages and plan explainers.
summary.zh: 3:4 单卡：免费 / Pro / 团队三档并排，价格当锚点往下读，右列包含左列，适合定价页与套餐说明。

summary.en: A tall graphic: no specs, just seven situations, each tagged with a verdict. The reader only has to find their own row.
summary.zh: 竖版长图：不摆参数，直接给七种处境，每种后面挂一个判定标签，读者只要找到自己那一行。

summary.en: A tall graphic: two candidates in one real table, row by row, the winning cell lifted with a dark fill so you can see at a glance who wins where.
summary.zh: 竖版长图：两个候选放进一张真表逐行比，赢的一格用深底反白顶起来，一眼扫下来就知道各自赢在哪。

summary.en: A tall graphic: three options side by side with the recommendation in the middle; each column opens with a situation rather than a name, because readers are looking for themselves.
summary.zh: 竖版长图：三个方案并排，中间一列是推荐项，每列第一行不是名字而是一句处境——读者在找哪一列是自己。

title.en: Time Shift · A Year Ago and Now
title.zh: 时间对比 · 一年前与现在

summary.en: A 3:4 card: a centred spine of labels, a year ago on the left and now on the right, both values of each item landing on the same row.
summary.zh: 3:4 单卡：一条居中的标签脊柱，左边一年前、右边现在，同一项的两个取值落在同一行上。

summary.en: A 1:1 card: one beam, two pans — worth it on the left, what it costs on the right, an empty checkbox before every line. The card lists both sides and hands you the pen.
summary.zh: 1:1 方卡：一根横梁两个托盘，左盘装值得、右盘装代价，每条前面留一个空方框——结论交给读者自己称。

summary.en: A 1:1 card: no left-right split — every row completes its own “old → new”, so you just scroll and read.
summary.zh: 1:1 方卡：不分左右两栏，每一行自己完成一次「旧 → 新」，顺着往下滑即可读完全部改动。

summary.en: A 3:4 card: three phones side by side with empty image wells. Drop in your own three onboarding screens, add the copy, and it is ready for review or posting.
summary.zh: 3:4 单卡：三台并排的手机与空图位，把自己的三张引导图拖进去配上文案，一张就能拿去评审或发布。

title.zh: 手工 DIY 图解长图

summary.en: A tall graphic where the materials-and-specs table takes as much room as the steps — DIY usually fails in the preparation, not in the hands.
summary.zh: 竖版长图：材料规格表与步骤各占一半篇幅——手工翻车多在准备而不在手上，所以先把材料写清楚。

summary.en: 3:4, five frames: each one a dark viewfinder with bright guide lines over the photo well, because composition can only be explained on the frame itself.
summary.zh: 3:4 五帧：每帧一个深色取景框，荧光参考线压在图位之上——构图必须画在取景框上才说得清。

summary.en: A 4:5 card, 2×2: all four steps on one card. Screenshot it and cook from it — nobody wants to swipe pages at the stove.
summary.zh: 4:5 单卡 2×2 四宫格：四步全放在一张卡上，截图存相册就能照着做，站在灶台前不用翻页。

summary.en: 4:5, six frames: every step fixes three numbers — how much, how long to wait, morning or night. Skincare goes wrong on dose and interval, not on order.
summary.zh: 4:5 六帧：每步固定给用量、停留时长与早晚场次三个数——护肤翻车多在用量和间隔上。

summary.en: A 4:5 card, the only dark one in the tutorial set: screenshot wells with numbered instructions, for tools and feature walkthroughs.
summary.zh: 4:5 单卡：教程档唯一一张深色，界面截图位配编号操作说明，适合工具与软件的功能讲解。

summary.en: 3:4, six frames: besides the action and the image well, each step fixes a done-condition and a time budget — you are finished when it looks like that.
summary.zh: 3:4 六帧：每步除了动作与图位，固定给一条完成判定和一个耗时预算——做到那个状态才算做完。

summary.en: A tall graphic: after the four-part structure it hands you a skeleton with underlined blanks — screenshot it and fill it in.
summary.zh: 竖版长图：讲完四段结构之后直接给一张带下划线空格的周报骨架，截图就能照着往里填。

summary.en: A tall graphic: every movement carries a fixed sets / reps / rest bar alongside the image well and the cues, because people save this to train by the numbers.
summary.zh: 竖版长图：每个动作除图位与要点外，还有一条固定格式的组数 / 次数 / 休息参数条，存图照着数做。

summary.en: 3:4, five boards: hook, an annotated excerpt, three insights, one quotable line, close. It takes a work apart into pieces you can carry away instead of retelling the plot.
summary.zh: 3:4 五板：钩子、带注解的原文、三个洞见、一句书摘、收束——把一部作品拆成能拿走的零件，不是复述剧情。

summary.en: 3:4, seven boards: places and routes alternate — the place boards feed the dreamers, the day route and the eat-and-stay table feed the planners.
summary.zh: 3:4 七板：照片与动线交替——地点板给做梦的读者，一日动线与吃住对照给做计划的读者。

summary.en: 3:4, six boards: every data board is followed by a non-data one, so nobody swipes past the third chart. For quarterly reviews and industry notes.
summary.zh: 3:4 六板：数据页之间强制夹入非数据页，避免读者划到第三张图表就跳过，适合季报与行业观察。

summary.en: 3:4, six boards: one strict visual master throughout — page number and title never move. On a carousel the previous board is gone, so consistency is not decoration.
summary.zh: 3:4 六板：一套严格的视觉母版贯穿全程，页码与标题永远在同一个位置——轮播划走就回不去，一致性是刚需。

summary.en: 3:4, six boards: one question per board, each with a hand-drawn question number in the corner. The question itself is the reason to swipe on.
summary.zh: 3:4 六板：一问一板，每板左上角一个手写问号编号——问题本身就是往下划的理由，不需要留悬念。

summary.en: 3:4, seven boards: a personal retrospective built on time — the timeline on board five is the load-bearing wall, and the first four boards are each one of its marks.
summary.zh: 3:4 七板：以时间为骨架的个人经历复盘，第五板那条时间轴是全套的承重墙，前四板都是它的一个刻度。

summary.en: 3:4, six boards: six tools unfolded one per board, with the last board listing them all with page numbers — the collection reader is here to save it.
summary.zh: 3:4 六板：六个工具逐板展开，最后一板连页码一起列成目录——合集档的读者目的只有一个，收藏。

summary.en: 3:4, six boards: one step per board, the finger is the progress bar. For crafts, software and everyday how-tos.
summary.zh: 3:4 六板：一板一步，手指就是进度条，划一次等于做完一步，适合手作、软件与生活教程。

summary.en: 3:4, eight boards: number boards run cold and reflection boards run warm, alternating. For year-end summaries and personal retrospectives.
summary.zh: 3:4 八板：数字页冷、感受页热，两种温度交替推进，适合年终总结与个人年度复盘。

title.zh: 测深海图 · 咨询策略档

summary.en: Chart-paper white against steel and ink blue: every slide leads with a conclusion and backs it with one sourced reading. Depth-profile bars and a sounding-track agenda carry all seven pages, for consulting deliverables and strategy reviews.
summary.zh: 海图暖白配钢蓝墨蓝，结论式标题加一条带来源的读数，深度剖面条与航迹目录贯穿七页，适合咨询交付与策略汇报。

title.zh: 潮痕石板 · 数据评审档

summary.en: Overview tiles, a trend line, a detail table, a risk list and a swimlane roadmap on slate grey — seven pages that walk one full data review, for quarterly retrospectives and metric meetings.
summary.zh: 石板灰底上的全景磁贴、趋势线、明细表、风险清单和泳道路线，七页走完一次数据评审，适合季度复盘与指标例会。

title.zh: 版心界行 · 中文排版档

summary.en: Built on the classical Chinese page: type block, column rules, marginal notes and a fishtail folio. Body lines stay under thirty characters, with facing columns and a quotation page that reward reading, for lectures and seminars.
summary.zh: 以版心、界行、天头批注和鱼尾页码立身的中文原生排版，正文每行不超三十字，双栏对读与引文页耐读，适合讲稿与研讨。

title.zh: 方格石墨 · 学术答辩档

summary.en: Graphite type on grid paper: problem and gap, method, two pages of results, limitations, conclusion and references — eight pages in defence order, for proposals and thesis defences.
summary.zh: 方格纸底配石墨灰字，问题与缺口、方法、图表两页结果、局限、结论到引用，八页照答辩顺序排好，适合开题与论文答辩。

title.zh: 卷宗亚麻 · 文档备忘档

summary.en: A linen-paper dossier from cover sheet through background, current data, analysis and option comparison to the resolution — eight pages that read as a standalone memo, for decision reviews.
summary.zh: 亚麻纸卷宗质感，从文件首页、背景、现状数据到方案对比与决议，八页写成一份能独立读完的备忘录，适合决策评审。

title.zh: 账簿勾格 · 竞品矩阵档

summary.en: Scoring criteria, the main matrix, quantile scales and a gap-versus-strength read-out on ledger ruling — seven pages that tell a competitive comparison like a balanced account, for vendor selection and market analysis.
summary.zh: 账簿格线上的评估口径、主矩阵、分位刻度与差距优势对照，七页把竞品比较讲成一笔可核对的账，适合选型与市场分析。

summary.en: A ten-slide startup pitch deck in deep blue and white: a theme cover, big cost-comparison figures, a three-curve conclusion, a five-step loop and three metrics for the first 90 days, for SaaS fundraising pitches and product launches.
summary.zh: 深蓝底白字的创业路演十页：主题封面、成本对比大数字、三条曲线结论、五步闭环、上线九十天三指标，适合 SaaS 融资路演与产品发布。

summary.en: An eleven-slide light, blue-toned review: an agenda, one KPI trio card for each of four business lines plus a growth engine and improvements, ending with next-quarter goals, for operating reviews and quarterly reporting.
summary.zh: 浅底蓝调的复盘十一页：议程页、四条业务线各一页 KPI 三联卡加增长引擎与待改进，结尾下季目标，适合经营复盘与季度汇报。

summary.en: A seven-slide off-white lesson in ink green: learning goals, two steps for partitioning and recursion, two partition demos with array cells and pivot highlights, and a complexity comparison table, for algorithms and programming teaching.
summary.zh: 米白纸感配墨绿的七页课件：学习目标、分区与递归两步、分区演示上下两页带数组格与基准高亮、复杂度对照表，适合算法与编程教学。

summary.en: One horizontal review board for the primary lockup, construction rationale, monochrome reversals and minimum-size survival — built for first-round concept handoff.
summary.zh: 横向品牌评审板：展示主锁定组合、构成逻辑、黑白反转与最小尺寸，适合首轮概念交付。

summary.en: Four review cells check shared semantic load, structural dependence, silhouette unity and whether the secondary reading feels discovered rather than attached.
summary.zh: 四格逐项检查共享承义、结构依存、轮廓统一与次级意象的自然出现，适合概念筛选和评审留痕。

summary.en: A 4:5 event invitation with a large topic title, paired time-and-place cards, three guests, a registration QR code and a host-logo row in deep blue-violet.
summary.zh: 4:5 活动邀请卡：主题大字、时间地点双卡、三位嘉宾、报名二维码和主办方 logo 行，深蓝紫调适合活动预热。

summary.en: A 4:5 livestream announcement with a bold topic, three countdown tiles, two speakers, a platform pill and a reservation QR card over a dark gradient.
summary.zh: 4:5 直播预告：主题大字配倒计时三格、两位主讲、平台胶囊和预约二维码卡，深色渐变带出开播提醒。

summary.en: A 4:5 hiring poster with an oversized role title, team-photo placeholder, requirements, salary and an application QR code on a light canvas.
summary.zh: 4:5 招聘海报：岗位大字、团队照片占位、编号要求、薪资与投递二维码，浅色版面方便替换职位信息。

summary.en: A warm 4:5 course recruitment card with a course title, launch-info bar, four highlight tiles, instructor, early-bird price and registration QR code.
summary.zh: 4:5 课程招募：课程名、开课信息条、四格亮点、讲师、早鸟价和报名二维码，暖色调适合招生发布。

summary.en: A 4:5 conference agenda with the event name, five-stop timeline, coffee break and sponsor-logo row in orange on black.
summary.zh: 4:5 大会议程：大会名、五场时间轴、茶歇和赞助 logo 行，黑底橙字适合会议日程发布。

summary.en: A minimal white 4:5 launch card with a product placeholder, three selling points, price, launch offer and purchase QR code.
summary.zh: 4:5 新品上市卡：产品占位、三条卖点、价格与首发优惠，再接购买二维码，极简白底突出产品。

summary.en: A 4:5 annual report card with four headline numbers, a yearly takeaway, a Top 3 ranking and a QR code on a purple gradient.
summary.zh: 4:5 年度数据报告：四大数字、年度一句话、Top3 榜单和二维码，渐变紫底适合年终复盘。

summary.en: A 3:4 festival poster with a bold headline, date and venue, three-stage line-up, three ticket tiers, ticket QR code and special support in neon contrast.
summary.zh: 3:4 音乐节海报：主标题、日期场地、三舞台阵容、三档票价、购票二维码和特别支持，荧光撞色适合演出预热。

summary.en: A paper-toned 4:5 book-club invite with title and author, cover placeholder, host, time and place, three discussion topics and a registration QR code.
summary.zh: 4:5 读书会邀请：书名作者、封面占位、领读人、时间地点、三话题和报名二维码，纸色底适合线下活动。

summary.en: A warm-orange 4:5 knowledge card with a numbered eyebrow, oversized title, definition, three numbered points and an account-and-QR footer, for a knowledge creator's series.
summary.zh: 暖橙纸感 4:5 知识卡：编号眉标、大字标题、一段定义、三条要点各带序号圆标，底部账号与二维码，适合知识类账号的系列卡片。

summary.en: A dark 1200×630 data card with a large headline metric and month-over-month badge, horizontal bars on the right and three secondary metrics along the bottom, for social sharing and weekly reports.
summary.zh: 深色 1200×630 数据卡：主指标大数字与环比徽标、右侧横向条形图、底部三格次要指标，适合社交分享与周报配图。

summary.en: A warm ivory three-screen ordering flow: a featured drink photo with categories, a menu with a category rail and cart bar, and an order page with a pickup code and progress, for food and retail apps.
summary.zh: 暖象牙底的三屏点单流程：主推新品大图与分类、左栏分类加购物车条的菜单、取餐码与制作进度的订单页，适合餐饮与零售小程序。

summary.en: Three cool-white, trust-teal screens: monthly balance and budget progress, a six-month spending chart with category shares, and an add-expense page with a category grid and keypad, for personal finance apps.
summary.zh: 冷白底信任青的三屏记账：本月结余与预算进度、近六个月支出柱图与分类占比、分类网格加数字键盘的记一笔页，适合个人理财类产品。

summary.en: Three charcoal screens with vital green: today's steps, streak and habit list, a workout detail with a cover image slot, and weekly activity bars with sleep and heart rate, for health and habit apps.
summary.zh: 深炭底活力绿的三屏：今日步数、连续打卡与习惯清单，带封面图位的课程详情，本周运动柱图与睡眠心率，适合健康与习惯养成产品。

summary.en: A 1440×900 store console: four business-overview numbers, an order list split by status and an order detail with notes and actions, with blue reserved for pending orders, for POS and kitchen systems.
summary.zh: 1440×900 门店桌面端：营业概览四数、按状态分栏的订单列表、带备注与操作键的订单详情，蓝色只标待处理，适合收银与后厨系统。

title.zh: 经营数据看板 · 桌面

summary.en: A 1440×900 admin overview: sidebar navigation, four KPI cards, a two-year revenue bar chart, channel shares and a recent-orders table, for e-commerce and SaaS back offices.
summary.zh: 1440×900 后台概览：侧栏导航、四张指标卡、两年对比收入柱图、渠道占比与最近订单表，适合电商与 SaaS 管理后台。

summary.en: A six-slide 4:3 course on warm paper with terracotta: cover, four-part agenda, three working principles, a first-week timeline, a who-to-ask grid and a dark closing checklist, for training and printed handouts.
summary.zh: 暖白纸感配陶土色的 4:3 六页课件：封面、四件事议程、三条做事原则、第一周时间轴、找谁帮忙四宫格、深色结尾清单，适合培训与打印讲义。

summary.en: A six-slide 4:3 research readout in deep indigo and mint: three method numbers, three key findings, a pain-point bar ranking, a five-stage emotion curve and prioritized recommendations, for user research reports.
summary.zh: 深靛底薄荷色的 4:3 六页研究汇报：方法三数字、三个关键发现、痛点横条排行、五阶段情绪曲线、分级产品建议，适合用户研究与调研汇报。

title.zh: 咖啡品牌官网 · 森林绿

summary.en: A warm-white and forest-green coffee brand page: a photo hero with three key numbers, four signature drink cards, a deep-green brand story band and three store cards with addresses and hours, for café, food and lifestyle brand sites.
summary.zh: 暖白配森林绿的咖啡品牌长页：带实拍主视觉与三组数字的首屏、四张招牌饮品卡、深绿品牌故事带、三家门店的地址与营业时间，适合餐饮与生活方式品牌官网。

title.zh: 产品介绍 · 蓝配荧光黄

summary.en: A five-slide 16:9 product intro in cobalt blue with a neon-yellow highlight: a full-bleed blue cover with a product UI mock, three values as a title-and-list spread, four workflow step cards, four use-case formats and a closing slide with a "start designing" prompt card, for product launches and tool introductions.
summary.zh: 钴蓝配荧光黄的 16:9 五页产品介绍：整页蓝底封面配产品界面示意、左标题右清单的三条价值、四步流程卡、四种成品场景、带「开始设计」输入卡的结束页，适合产品发布与创作工具介绍。

summary.en: A five-slide 4:3 product intro in cobalt blue with a neon-yellow highlight: a stacked blue cover with a product UI strip, three values in a vertical list, a 2×2 grid of workflow steps, a 2×2 grid of use cases and a closing slide with a "start designing" prompt card, for meeting-room projectors and printed handouts.
summary.zh: 钴蓝配荧光黄的 4:3 五页产品介绍：上下构图的蓝底封面配产品界面条、纵排三条价值、2×2 流程卡、2×2 成品场景、带「开始设计」输入卡的结束页，适合会议室投影与打印讲义。

title.zh: 咖啡的世界 · 知识轮播

summary.en: A five-card warm-apricot magazine carousel: a cover photo with contents, arabica vs robusta side by side, the coffee belt's three growing regions, three roast-level swatches, and four flavour dimensions with tasting notes, for explainers and category guides.
summary.zh: 暖杏色杂志排版的五页知识卡：封面主图与目录、阿拉比卡与罗布斯塔对照、咖啡带三大产区、三档烘焙色块、风味四维度与风味词，适合科普与品类知识分享。

summary.en: Three screenshot cards with blue highlights, one per step: a series tag, a STEP number and action title, a mock screen you replace by dropping in your own screenshot, a blue ring and “Tap” label on the one thing to tap, plus a tip bar and next-step cue, for phone and software how-tos.
summary.zh: 蓝色标注重点的三张截图教程：一步一张，顶栏系列标签、STEP 序号与动作标题、可拖入真截图替换的示意界面、蓝圈加「轻点」标出要点的那一处、提示条与下一步引导，适合手机与软件操作教学。

summary.en: A long indigo data graphic: three big numbers for posts, reads and followers, this-week-versus-last paired bars, a seven-day reading chart and three takeaways, all clearly marked as sample data.
summary.zh: 靛蓝深色页头的一周数据长图：发布、阅读、关注三个大数，本周对上周的成对对比条，七天阅读柱图与三条结论，全图标明示例数据。

title.zh: 从灵感到发布流程长图

summary.en: A pine-green five-step flow: capture ideas, outline, first draft, polish visuals and check and publish, with numbered circles joined by a line and one how-to sentence and one output per step, for tutorials and workflow tips.
summary.zh: 松绿色的五步流程长图：记录想法、整理结构、完成初稿、打磨视觉、检查发布，编号圆用连线串起，每步一句做法和一项产出，适合教程与工作方法分享。

summary.en: A slate-and-amber comparison that favours neither side: definition cards for starting blank and starting from an example, a four-row table (starting point, editing, freedom, best for) and who each suits, with no efficiency claims.
summary.zh: 石板灰与琥珀两侧同权的对比长图：「从空白开始」与「从示例开始」两张定义卡，起点、修改方式、自由度、适用场景四行对照表，最后写清各自适合谁，不含任何效率数据。

title.zh: 城市音乐节海报 · 两种版式

summary.en: A black and neon-green event set: a 3:4 main poster (giant title, sound-wave bars, date and venue, line-up and ticket bar) plus a 1:1 social square with a neon date band, for music festivals, gigs and city events.
summary.zh: 黑底荧光绿的一套活动视觉：3:4 主海报（超大标题、声浪柱、日期地点、演出阵容与购票条）加 1:1 社交方图（荧光绿日期条），适合音乐节、演出与城市活动。

summary.en: 封面、三个操作步骤和结尾行动号召，替换截图与说明即可发布。
summary.zh: 封面、三个操作步骤和结尾行动号召，替换截图与说明即可发布。

summary.en: 封面、三个论点和总结页，适合把一个观点拆成可滑动的连续卡片。
summary.zh: 封面、三个论点和总结页，适合把一个观点拆成可滑动的连续卡片。

summary.en: 封面、目录、要点、数据、图表和结尾，16:9 投影比例，替换文案即可上台。
summary.zh: 封面、目录、要点、数据、图表和结尾，16:9 投影比例，替换文案即可上台。

summary.en: A single 3:4 card with a headline, four takeaways, and a byline. Swap the copy and post it.
summary.zh: 3:4 单张图文卡，标题、四条要点和署名条，换掉文案就能发小红书。

summary.en: A 1:1 card in the same layout, compact enough for a post header or a social share.
summary.zh: 1:1 方形卡，同一套版式的紧凑版，适合公众号头图与朋友圈。

summary.en: 左右并置的前后对比，配改动说明，适合复盘与作品展示。
summary.zh: 左右并置的前后对比，配改动说明，适合复盘与作品展示。

summary.en: A cover, the problem, the solution, the numbers, a roadmap and a contact slide. Big type on a dark ground, built for fundraising and launch talks.
summary.zh: 封面、问题、方案、数据、里程碑和联系页，深底大字，适合融资路演与产品发布。

summary.en: A course cover, objectives, a concept walkthrough, a worked example, a comparison table and a wrap-up. Paper-white, easy on the eyes for a full class.
summary.zh: 课程封面、学习目标、概念讲解、例题、对比表和小结作业，纸白底耐看，适合上课投影。

summary.en: White space, oversized type, one centred line per slide — nine pages without a single card, and an agenda of nothing but rules and numbers. Built for launches and keynotes.
summary.zh: 纯白留白、超大字号、一页一句话居中，九页里没有一张卡片，目录只有细线和数字，适合发布会与主题演讲。

summary.en: A dark gradient ground with frosted-glass cards, covering architecture, benchmarks and a customer wall. For developer product launches.
summary.zh: 深色渐变底加玻璃拟态卡，含架构、性能对比与客户墙，适合开发者产品发布。

summary.en: A light marketing page built on near-black panels and one orange accent: navigation, a hero with a product shot, three capability cards, a workflow walkthrough, testimonials and a subscribe footer. Swap the copy and it is a site.
summary.zh: 浅底黑卡配橙色主色的产品营销长页：导航、Hero 与产品截图、能力三卡、工作流演示、客户评价和订阅页脚，换掉文案就是一版官网。

summary.en: A paper-white broadsheet product page: an interactive hero demo, capability columns, an analytics board, an old-versus-new comparison and three pricing tiers. Built for SaaS sites and product launches.
summary.zh: 纸白报刊风的产品长页：Hero 交互演示卡、能力分栏、数据看板、新旧方案对比和三档定价，适合 SaaS 官网与产品发布。

summary.en: A 3:4 card on near-black: two lines of oversized type over one yellow highlight bar. One sentence and nothing else, built for opinions and quotes.
summary.zh: 3:4 墨底金句卡，两行巨标题加一条亮黄标语，只讲一句话，适合观点与语录。
